mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms.image_work (created_by, title, json_data) VALUES (#{createdBy}, #{title}, #{jsonData})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cms.image_work WHERE id = #{id} AND created_by = #{createdBy}
mapper.select: SELECT id, created_by as createdBy, title, json_data as jsonData, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM cms.image_work WHERE created_by = #{createdBy} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT count(*) FROM cms.image_work WHERE created_by = #{createdBy}
